How much does it cost to run a hedge trimmer?

A typical hedge trimmer uses about 500 watts (400–700W depending on the model). Used for 30 minutes per use, 1 use a week, for 4 months of the year, it costs about 6.6p per use and £1.14 a year at the current price cap rate.

Cost per use
6.6p
About £1.14 a year at 30 minutes per use, 1 use a week, 4 months a year.

Standing charge not included.

About these figures

Source for the typical figure: Typical range (estimate). See how we calculate.

Ways to cut the cost

  • Corded tools only draw power while running, so costs are small; it's runtime that adds up.
  • Charge cordless tools when needed, not continuously.
  • Keep filters and blades clean so motors work less hard.

Questions

How much does it cost to run a hedge trimmer per hour?

At 26.32p/kWh, a 500W model costs about 13p an hour while it's running.

How much does it cost to run a hedge trimmer per year?

About £1.14 a year, based on 30 minutes per use, 1 use a week, 4 months a year. Change the sliders above to match how you use yours.

Is the standing charge included?

No. You pay the standing charge every day whether or not the appliance is used, so it isn't part of the cost of running it.

How do I find my hedge trimmer's actual power use?

Check the rating label, plug or manual for the wattage, or the energy label for kWh figures. A plug-in energy monitor shows exactly what it uses.
